countryCode.title: Country / Market
countryCode.description: Select the target market country code (e.g. ID for Indonesia, US for United States, SG for Singapore, MY for Malaysia).

category.title: Niche Category
category.description: Filter by industry niche: all, food, otomotif, beauty, fashion, education, tech.

period.title: Lookback Period (Days)
period.description: Historical duration to find proven winning campaigns (7, 30, or 180 days).

objective.title: Campaign Objective
objective.description: Filter by advertiser goal. 15 = Product Sales (Real Checkout Conversion), 3 = Conversions, 8 = Lead Generation.

sortBy.title: Sort Metric
sortBy.description: Choose sorting order for top ads: cvr (Conversion Rate), like (Popularity), or ctr (Click-Through Rate).

maxResults.title: Max Ads to Extract
maxResults.description: Total number of winning ads to return.

enrichHookRetention.title: Enrich Hook Retention Curve (2s & 6s)
enrichHookRetention.description: When enabled, fetches second-by-second audience retention curves and grades the opening hook (GOD_TIER >= 30%, STRONG >= 20%).

filterAuthenticOnly.title: 🛡️ Filter Out AI Slop & Injected Bot Likes
filterAuthenticOnly.description: Eliminates low-effort AI slideshow clips (< 12s), suspected SMM bot injections (massive likes with zero CTR), and dead-drop hooks.
